# ADR-3270: AWS backups: Documented shorter retention for nonprod vault 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Nonprod data avoids need long retention.

## Decision

Nonprod MAY adopt a documented shorter retention for nonprod vault 6 (AWS-backups-6) when cost outweighs long retention.

## Consequences

Prod retention remains stricter.
